''[[PE01|The Champion]]'' ({{pkmn|Evolutions}}) |enva=N/A |jpva=N/A }} |} '''Jack'''[[Pokémon Sword & Pokémon Shield: The Official Galar Region Strategy Guide]], p. 16 (Japanese: '''ポケモンセンターの{{tt|職員|しょくいん}}'''Pocket Monsters Sword/Shield Official Guidebook Complete Story Walkthrough + Galar Pokédex, p. 61 ''Pokémon Center Staff'') is a character in {{g|Sword and Shield}} who can be found behind the left counter in every [[Pokémon Center]] in [[Galar]]. He offers the services of the [[Name Rater]], [[Memory Girl]], [[Move Reminder]], and [[Move Deleter]] from previous games, being able to change a Pokémon's [[nickname]], check a Pokémon's [[Memory (game mechanic)|memories]] (after the player has obtained three [[Badge]]s), have a Pokémon remember a [[move]], and have a Pokémon forget a move. All of Jack's services are free of charge. His name is derived from the term 'jack-of-all-trades', referring to the multiple different services he can provide. He shares his model with the {{tc|Café Master}} [[Pokémon Trainer|Trainer]] class. He is always accompanied by an {{p|Indeedee}}, the [[gender]] of which varies depending on the specific Pokémon Center. ==Pokémon== {| width="100px" | {{ActivePoké|Jack|Indeedee|876Indeedee-Male.png|psychic|normal|size=100px|link=no}} ♂ | {{ActivePoké|Jack|Indeedee|876Indeedee-Female.png|psychic|normal|size=100px|link=no}} ♀ |} ==Gallery== ===Models=== {{incomplete|section}} ==Quotes== [[File:Jack SwSh.png|thumb|250px|Jack in Pokémon Sword and Shield]] ===[[Pokémon Sword and Shield]]=== ;Any [[Pokémon Center]] :''"Got some Pokémon questions?
